messages:
elaine: Quick check-in for Springboard cutover tomorrow 10:30 PT. Need final values: KMS key ARN, cross-account role name + trust policy (with ExternalId), audit log S3 bucket and object-lock status, egress CIDRs. Please post by 18:00 PT today. Tagging @springboard-sre

springboard-sre: KMS ARN: arn:aws:kms:us-west-1:7788990011:key/sb-7c6d. Cross-account role name: RedwoodAccess_Springboard. Trust policy will include ExternalId springboard-ext-2026. Audit bucket: s3://springboard-redwood-audit. Object lock currently OFF. Egress: allow 10.60.0.0/16 -> 54.12.34.0/24:443 and 10.60.2.0/24 -> 13.14.15.16:123 (NTP)

tom: Network note: during staging we hit stale DNS cache that pointed redwood-api.private.springboard to old LB. Please set internal A record redwood-api.private.springboard -> 10.60.2.9 and TTL=45. Also confirm resolver allows split-horizon lookups.

zayd: retention ask: Springboard requested 45d retention for audit logs. We recommended 90d by default; customer insists 45d due to compliance. Noted as non-blocker but documenting for renewal discussion. :page_with_curl:

elaine: renewal flag: Springboard at month 11 of 12 trial. If cutover has >1 incident we escalate to sales to avoid churn. Flagging @sales for heads-up. :warning:

deploy-bot: dry-run job queued for 2026-03-24T17:00:00Z (job dj-9988). Will post results here.

springboard-sre: FYI KMS rotation scheduled next week; we'll pause rotation until after cutover to be safe. Also creating KMS alias redwood-emergency for fallback.

deploy-bot: dry-run started: 2026-03-24T17:00:12Z (dj-9988).

springboard-sre: dry-run results: healthz OK, /v1/embeddings had one 429 during burst then recovered. No audit upload errors. Paste smoke command and sample output below.

Command:
`curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN" https://redwood-api.private.springboard/healthz | jq .`

Sample output:
`{ "status": "ok", "uptime_seconds": 12834, "components": {"runtime": "ok", "kv_cache": "warm" } }`

springboard-sre: opened ticket SB-77 for embedding burst tuning. Will add retry policy to runbook.

elaine: thanks all. Leaving thread open for final confirmation if any of the above items change (IAM ExternalId, object lock, or KMS alias). Once confirmed we'll schedule the production cutover slot. :rocket:
